# Docs for projects by Pratyay Mustafi

> Documentation for open-source developer tools by Pratyay Mustafi: setup guides,
> configuration recipes, and technical reference for Ensor, Dynamic UPI QR, Drawy,
> and Newsy. Built with Zola; all pages are Markdown and open source at
> https://github.com/Pratyay360/pratyay360.github.io

## Core pages

- [Introduction](https://pratyay360.github.io/): What this documentation site covers.
- [Getting Started](https://pratyay360.github.io/getting-started/): Quick navigation to every project guide.
- [Drawy Documentation](https://pratyay360.github.io/drawy-documentation/): Overview of the Drawy web app and FAQ.
- [Ensor Secrets Redaction](https://pratyay360.github.io/ensor-secret-detection-redaction-cli/): Go CLI for scanning a codebase for hardcoded secrets and redacting them.
- [LightCMS](https://pratyay360.github.io/lightcms/): Git-based CMS for static sites.

## Guides

- [Drawy getting started](https://pratyay360.github.io/guides/drawy-getting-started/): Create an account, draw your first canvas, share it, and export your work.
- [Drawy Libraries](https://pratyay360.github.io/guides/drawy-library/): Save and reuse Excalidraw libraries across canvases.
- [Drawy Privacy and Security](https://pratyay360.github.io/guides/drawy-privacy/): What Drawy stores, what it does not store, and how to remove your data.
- [Self-hosting Drawy](https://pratyay360.github.io/guides/drawy-selfhost/): Run your own instance with the TanStack Start app, the realtime worker and Postgres.
- [DrawX](https://pratyay360.github.io/guides/drawx/): Offline desktop whiteboard for Linux, macOS, and Windows.

## Optional

- [Privacy](https://pratyay360.github.io/privacy/): Site privacy policy.
